description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named PseudoStaticContentController. Its purpose is to handle HTTP requests for static content, optionally rewriting URLs and appending JSTL interpretation suffixes, and managing cache control via last modified timestamps. The class implements Controller, LastModified, and GlobalPropertyListener interfaces to integrate with the web framework and global property settings.

classes.name: PseudoStaticContentController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for serving static content with optional URL rewriting and JSTL support, including cache management based on global property changes.

methods.name: getInterpretJstl
methods.description: Returns whether JSTL processing is enabled.

methods.name: setInterpretJstl
methods.description: Sets whether JSTL processing is enabled.

methods.name: getRewrites
methods.description: Returns the map of URL rewrites.

methods.name: setRewrites
methods.description: Sets the map of URL rewrites.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, applies URL rewrites, appends a suffix if JSTL is enabled, and returns the corresponding view.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns a static last modified timestamp when JSTL interpretation is enabled; otherwise returns -1.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Updates the static last modified timestamp.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Resets the last modified timestamp when a global property changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets the last modified timestamp when a global property is deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Confirms support for any global property name.

methods.name: invalidateCachedResources
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp to invalidate cached resources.
